name: Juan José Holguín
statement: I blend art and logic to create stories you can click, swipe, and feel.
about: I design clear digital experiences with personality. I animate in After Effects, illustrate in Illustrator and Photoshop, and prototype apps in Figma. I also code in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, and I am learning Python.

awards.title: Best Visual Design
awards.detail: For Carrera a la Locura, a board game built with basic code and NFC.

awards.title: Best Audiovisual Design
awards.detail: For Besos de Vino, a stop-motion animated poem.

experience.org: Interactive Media Design program, Universidad Icesi
